hypothesis: Conditioned on the real-weight gain route and sign-only fused kernel gates passing, the three-bit gain side channel can be added to one-call direct 1.5-bit mask64 plus INT4 Clark-Hash correction at the exact Qwen3.8-27B MLP shapes while retaining at least 95 percent of sign-only fused AVX2 throughput, agreeing with explicit T x plus A times R_gain x within 5e-4 absolute error, and retaining at most 1.57 complete component bits per weight

scope.claim_boundary: synthetic exact-support full-shape fused microkernel only; not a real learned route, complete layer, token-throughput, model-quality, semi-lossless, or breakthrough result

parents.skip_rule: if either parent rejects, emit a terminal valid nonpromotion without compiling or benchmarking

formula.weight_approximation: W approximately equals T plus A R_gain
formula.runtime: y equals T x plus A times R_gain x
formula.ternary_runtime: mask64 support plus support-ordered signs with row-anchor scale4
formula.gain_route: one learned bucket sign and three-bit positive gain index per input coordinate
formula.correction: ratio-128 signed INT4 A with one FP16 scale per output row
formula.fusion_boundary: one public C call with one output buffer; R_gain x scratch is at most 136 FP32 values and no dense residual is materialized

gain_route.compute_gain_codebook: eight FP32 values expanded once at load

measurement.route: deterministic synthetic one-sparse signed routing with uniformly sampled three-bit gain indices and eight positive FP16 gain levels
measurement.correction_codes: deterministic signed INT4 in [-7,7] with FP16 row scales
measurement.activation: deterministic signed INT8 with per-group FP32 scales
measurement.threading: one process pinned to one physical CPU; kernels are single-threaded
measurement.comparison: one-call gain-routed AVX2 BMI2 kernel versus the sign-only one-call fused AVX2 BMI2 parent implementation using identical mask64 codes route buckets route signs correction and activation
measurement.timing_order: alternated by case to reduce systematic first-run bias
measurement.correctness_oracle: independent mask64 scalar base plus NumPy dequantized gain-route sketch and signed-INT4 correction
measurement.compiler: system C compiler with C11 O3 Wall Wextra Werror shared PIC and mtune=native

promotion_rules: every shape must independently meet correctness storage and gain-overhead thresholds
the sign and gain candidates must use identical mask64 codes scales bucket routes signs correction codes and activation
the correction must be checked against an explicit dequantized T x plus A times R_gain x oracle
disk bit packing and expanded compute-layout bytes must both be reported
a pass only establishes that the gain side channel is computationally cheap enough to integrate
real learned coefficients capability and end-to-end token throughput require separate gates
a failed gate remains a terminal useful result and requires a separately versioned optimization
infrastructure-invalid work is neither a zero nor a completed result
Qwen 4B compute is forbidden in this research lane
this benchmark cannot establish semi-lossless compression or a scientific breakthrough
